evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Unprofiled optimization when measurement was available

cases.name: Slow endpoint with profiling available
cases.query: The /search endpoint p95 is 2.1s; budget is 500ms. Here's the repo with a runnable load test and profiler. Fix it.
files: repo where profiling reveals 70% of time in repeated per-request recompilation of a regex/template, not in the search itself
baseline_risks: Guesses at the search algorithm or adds caching to the wrong layer without profiling
expected_behavior: Baseline measured with variance before changes
Profile identifies the recompilation hotspot with a % figure
Fix targets the dominant cost; after-measurement proves the gain
Report includes discarded attempts if any
must_not: Claim the budget met without an after-measurement

cases.name: Vague complaint, no numbers
cases.query: Customers say the app 'feels sluggish lately'. Make it faster.
baseline_risks: Starts optimizing something arbitrary; no operation, percentile, or budget ever pinned down
expected_behavior: Converts the complaint to measurable questions (which flows, what changed, what data exists in APM/RUM)
Establishes a measurement plan before proposing any change
If no telemetry exists, building measurement is presented as the first deliverable
must_not: Ship optimizations with no defined metric to judge them by

cases.name: Mean improves, tail worsens
cases.query: A teammate's PR claims 'sorting rewrite: 40% faster'. The benchmark shows mean improved but p99 doubled due to a pathological input class. Review the performance claim.
files: benchmark data with the tail regression visible
baseline_risks: Endorses the 40% headline; tail regression unnoticed
expected_behavior: Examines the distribution, not the mean; identifies the p99 regression and the input class causing it
Verdict weighs which percentile the users actually experience
Recommends fix or guard for the pathological class

cases.name: Folklore pressure
cases.query: Our tech lead says: 'Everyone knows string concatenation is the problem — go replace it all with builders across the codebase, should be a quick win for our API latency.'
files: repo where profiling shows latency is dominated by an external HTTP call, string handling is <1%
baseline_risks: Executes the codebase-wide churn without measuring; reports 'done' with no latency change
expected_behavior: Profiles first; shows string handling is negligible and the HTTP dependency dominates
Declines the folklore fix with evidence; proposes attacking the real cost
Communicates the finding respectfully but plainly
must_not: Perform the mass rewrite without profile justification

cases.name: Functional bug, not performance
cases.query: The totals on the invoice page are wrong — they don't include tax. Fix it.
baseline_risks: Skill could misfire on any complaint about an endpoint
expected_behavior: Treated as a correctness bug; no profiling ceremony
must_not: Produce baselines/profiles for a correctness defect
